verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-261007-439 dated 07.10.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to the Soony DC Hamburg. It covers POs 4500318722 and 4500318731. Line 1 is CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6, 12.500 PCS (12,500) in 25 packages. Line 2 is CMP-GAM-011 Activation Code Leaflet, 280.000 PCS (280,000) in 56 packages. The only handwriting is the signature 'Meyer K.' in blue ink.
The bottom of the page is blank, and there are no stamps.
The page has a barcode at the top right.
